|lore=Jabba The Hutt’s clan requires all members to carry ritual scarring identifying them forever as heirs to the Nal Hutta legacy. These tattoos are considered marks of power.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Bounty Hunters and your [Independent] starships are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, when a bounty hunter uses a non-[[Permanent Weapon]] weapon to hit a character, target is forfeit -2 and opponent places top card of Reserve Deck in Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history={{Card errata/Desilijic Tattoo (V) (Virtual Set 5)}}
|printings={{Card versions/Desilijic Tattoo}}
|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Desilijic Tattoo (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Original)|Original]] and [[Desilijic Tattoo (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The remastered Independent glyph retains the ship affiliation while dropping the unique-only limitation. It changes the unreducible Force loss from the top of Reserve Deck to directing that card to Lost Pile. The bonuses, bounty hunter trigger, target forfeit and Alter immunity remain. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040206210427id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet08252003.pdf#page=1 August 2003 ruling on who uses the non-permanent weapon].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 35. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Desilijic Tattoo]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
